title: Multiplayer Lobby HUD Concept
summary: Lobby and matchmaking UI for squads, roles, readiness, ranked constraints, and social clarity.
prompt: Design a multiplayer lobby HUD for {argument name="game_title" default="Apex Anvil"}. Include squad slots, role selection, readiness states, ranked tier, cross-platform control indicators, party voice status, matchmaking region, anti-cheat trust indicator, map vote, and accessible chat controls. The layout must support controller navigation, keyboard and mouse, and quick competitive scanning without visual noise.
